subject: Banking
title: The Keating Five Scandal
description: A quick, practical guide to The Keating Five Scandal.

hook.text: Five US senators accepted $1.3 million from banker Charles Keating.

buildup.text: Keating ran Lincoln Savings and Loan. He used depositors' money on junk bonds and luxury real estate projects.

discovery.text: When regulators investigated, Keating called his senators. They held a meeting pressuring the regulators to back off.

twist.text: Lincoln Savings collapsed in 1989. 23,000 depositors lost savings. Keating went to prison.

climax.text: The Keating Five showed how money buys political protection for bad banking.

punchline.text: $1.3 million in donations. Five senators pressured regulators.

quiz.question: What did the five senators do for Charles Keating?
options: Pressured regulators to stop investigating his S&L
